coverage.sourceFile: FEC 2025-2026 contributions from committees to candidates (PAS2)

methodology: Direct committee-to-candidate transactions use FEC spender-side 24K, 24P and 24Z records after keeping the latest filing version for each FEC transaction ID. Sector labels are a POLITICS browsing taxonomy based on committee names, not FEC industry classifications.
